summary: Bollinger Bands: a 20-bar SMA with bands two standard deviations above and below, filled between them.
overview: Bollinger Bands draw a middle line (orange) with an upper and lower band (blue) on the price chart. The bands widen when price swings more and tighten when it is quiet.
The area between the bands is lightly shaded.
how: Basis = SMA(close, 20). Upper = basis + 2 x standard deviation of close over 20 bars. Lower = basis - 2 x the same standard deviation.
Length, source and multiplier can be changed.
use: Some traders watch a tight squeeze of the bands as a sign of low volatility before a larger move.
Use touches of the bands to see price stretched from its average.
In strong trends price can walk along one band; some traders read that as strength.
Use the basis as a mid-line for pullbacks.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
A touch of a band is not a signal on its own.
